items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (October 2026)
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0, known as BlockStrap) leading to arbitrary code execution, and an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8) allowing unauthenticated code execution. Adobe is not aware of in-the-wild exploitation for these specific issues, but recommends applying the APSB26-146 hotfix in addition.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (September 2026)
items.summary: This emergency update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0, known as StyleSmuggler) that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (September 2026)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200). Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (August 2026)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, led by an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) and two stored cross-site scripting flaws. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (July 2026)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses fourteen vulnerabilities, led by an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) and several incorrect authorization and stored cross-site scripting flaws. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution.
